item.title: In 1993, Chile adopted an Indigenous Law that enabled land restitution; by 2023...
item.description: Since 1993, over 510,000 acres have been returned to Mapuche communities in Chile under the Indigenous Law. A study revealed minimal changes in forest cover on the restituted lands.
